user.title: Choose your engines
user.description: Assist uses the primary, and switches to the backup whenever the primary can't answer. For a Wyoming primary on a machine that can be off, enter its address here and don't add it as a Wyoming entry: an entry can stall Home Assistant's startup for 5 minutes while that machine is away. Use the same voice on both text-to-speech engines so a switch doesn't change how replies sound.

data_description.primary_timeout: How long a primary may take before Assist switches to the backup. Too short and a slow primary is abandoned for no gain.
